subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should #38091 remain the umbrella tracker for WebChat reconnect plus embedded-run `terminated` behavior, or should maintainers route visible in-flight recovery to narrower issues and create a separate embedded-run termination tracker?
rationale: Current main partially recovers active session state and narrower issues own parts of the behavior, but the original report includes real `terminated` logs and a commenter observed termination without a matching reconnect, so automation should not decide the permanent session-reconnect contract or close/split boundary.

options.title: Keep umbrella open until narrower fixes land
options.body: Retain #38091 as the broader user-facing tracker while #90755, #41064, #42213, and any embedded-run termination proof converge on a complete recovery story.

options.title: Split into a termination-specific tracker
options.body: Move the Control UI visibility and busy-state parts to the narrower open issues, then keep or create a focused issue for embedded runs ending `terminated` without clear reconnect causality.

options.title: Close after accepting partial mitigations
options.body: Close only if maintainers explicitly decide the current send retry, Stop visibility, and history refresh behavior satisfy the product contract despite missing full run adoption proof.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open until narrower fixes land
recommendation.body: Retain #38091 as the broader user-facing tracker while #90755, #41064, #42213, and any embedded-run termination proof converge on a complete recovery story.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available current-main routing signal for the refactored Gateway and Control UI paths that would carry a replacement contract.
